        WHEN (s.bwhz / s.centerfreqmhz < 0.0001 AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.1 AND sc.sigclasstype != 'Natural') THEN 'Strong NTM'
        WHEN (s.bwhz / s.centerfreqmhz < 0.0005 AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.5 AND sc.sigclasstype != 'Natural') THEN 'Moderate NTM'

    END AS ntm_classification
FROM signals s

LIMIT 20;
